config.threshold_rule: Maximize calibration acceptance with >=30 accepted and <=5% empirical error; tie choose lowest cutoff. Null means defer all. No finite-sample risk guarantee.

exclusion_rule: Official BANKING77 train only; normalized exclusion of original development/calibration and ALL official test texts; deduplicate train exact normalized text. Fit vectorizer solely on retained train. Original 200 calibration only chooses cutoff before fresh test prediction.
model_binary: Not persisted; deterministic refit from pinned inputs, fixed config, recorded versions.
